nodes.label: GeneralizedRCNN
nodes.desc: Single nn.Module that assembles backbone, proposal generator and ROI heads, then routes training forward and eval inference.

nodes.label: build_backbone
nodes.desc: Registry-driven factory that turns cfg.MODEL.BACKBONE.NAME into a Backbone, optionally wrapped with FPN.

nodes.label: ResNet
nodes.desc: Classic stem-plus-stages ResNet producing C2-C5 feature maps, with freeze-at and per-stage channel controls.

nodes.label: FPN
nodes.desc: Feature Pyramid Network that lateral-merges C2-C5 into multi-scale p2-p6 features for small and large objects.

nodes.label: RPN
nodes.desc: Region Proposal Network: scores anchor boxes, regresses deltas, and filters to the top-k object proposals.

nodes.label: DefaultAnchorGenerator
nodes.desc: Tiles anchor boxes of configured sizes, aspect ratios and angles at every position of each feature map.

nodes.label: StandardROIHeads
nodes.desc: Pools features on proposals, classifies and refines boxes, and optionally predicts masks and keypoints.

nodes.label: DefaultPredictor
nodes.desc: Single-image convenience wrapper: builds the model, loads weights, resizes and converts the input image.

nodes.label: DefaultTrainer
nodes.desc: Opinionated train loop wiring data loaders, optimizer, checkpointer and periodic hooks over TrainerBase.

nodes.label: CfgNode defaults
nodes.desc: yacs _C tree holding every default: backbone name, anchor sizes, RPN and ROI head thresholds, data paths.

nodes.label: DetectionCheckpointer
nodes.desc: Loads and saves pkl/torch checkpoints and recognizes Caffe2-era model zoo weights for compatibility.

nodes.label: build_detection_train_loader
nodes.desc: Builds a training dataloader with a dataset mapper, aspect-ratio grouping, shuffling and infinite sampling.
